caption: The drawing depicts a large, round ceramic jar with a wide body that tapers toward the base and a domed, golden lid topped with a small knob. The surface of the jar is decorated with blue floral and ornamental patterns, including vines, leaves, and stylized flowers arranged symmetrically, primarily around the upper and lower sections of the jar. In the center of the jar, amidst the blue designs, there is a white oval-shaped area bordered by decorative blue elements, within which the text "BEST ECARATTE" is written in blue, capital letters. The jar sits against a plain, light-colored background that is bordered by a fine-lined rectangular frame. The name "JOHN FISK" is written in blue in the lower right corner of the drawing. The color palette consists mainly of blue, gold, and shades of white and gray.
title: Sugar Bowl
